note: Style guide renders a preview of common theme elements per active theme. Main page /admin/appearance/styleguide (route styleguide.page, permission 'view style guides'). Dynamic per-theme routes styleguide.<theme> generated by StyleguideRoutes (route_callbacks) for each enabled non-hidden theme; a theme negotiator (theme.negotiator.styleguide) renders each in its theme. It defines a Styleguide plugin type: manager plugin.manager.styleguide, subdir Plugin/Styleguide, interface StyleguideInterface::items(), base StyleguidePluginBase, generic @Plugin annotation, alter hook styleguide_info; ships plugins default_styleguide, comment_styleguide, filter_styleguide, image_styleguide, layout_styleguide, search_styleguide, views_styleguide. hook_styleguide_alter(&$items) alters items. No config of its own, no Drush. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real live state: introspection reads the registered plugins / enabled-theme routes; execution grants the real permission to a role and enables a theme's style guide, verified against live state. The stark theme route only appears after a router/cache rebuild.

evals.prompt: With the Drupal styleguide module enabled, at what path do I view the theme style guide, and what permission is required to see it?
evals.expected_output: View it at /admin/appearance/styleguide (route styleguide.page), which shows the guide for the current default theme. The 'view style guides' permission is required.

evals.prompt: How do I add my own elements to the styleguide module's preview page from a custom module? What plugin type / interface do I implement?
evals.expected_output: Create a plugin under src/Plugin/Styleguide implementing Drupal\styleguide\StyleguideInterface (extend StyleguidePluginBase) with a generic @Plugin annotation (id + label) and an items() method returning your elements (keyed arrays with title/content). The plugin.manager.styleguide manager discovers it.

evals.prompt: The styleguide module can show the guide for a specific theme, not just the default one. How are those per-theme pages provided, and how does the page render in the selected theme?
evals.expected_output: For each enabled non-hidden theme a dynamic route styleguide.<theme> at /admin/appearance/styleguide/<theme> is generated by StyleguideRoutes (route_callbacks), shown as tabs. A theme negotiator (theme.negotiator.styleguide / StyleguideThemeNegotiator) sets the active theme to the one in the route so the guide renders in that theme.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which Styleguide plugins are registered (the plugins that supply the style guide's preview elements)? Give at least the plugin id that provides the default/common HTML elements.
evals.expected_output: The registered Styleguide plugins (from plugin.manager.styleguide) are default_styleguide, comment_styleguide, filter_styleguide, image_styleguide, layout_styleguide, search_styleguide and views_styleguide. The default/common elements come from default_styleguide.

evals.prompt: A non-default theme has recently been enabled on this site. Besides the default theme, for which theme can you now view a Style guide, and what is the exact path to that theme's style guide page?
evals.expected_output: The core 'stark' theme was enabled, so its style guide is available at /admin/appearance/styleguide/stark (route styleguide.stark).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a role with machine name styleguide_viewer that currently cannot view the theme style guides. Using the styleguide module's permission, grant that role the ability to view style guides, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The styleguide_viewer role is granted the 'view style guides' permission (e.g. via the permissions form or Role::load('styleguide_viewer')->grantPermission('view style guides')->save()), so hasPermission('view style guides') is TRUE.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, make the styleguide module's Style guide available for the core 'stark' theme, so that its guide is reachable at /admin/appearance/styleguide/stark. Apply the change to the live site (remember its dynamic route must actually exist).
evals.expected_output: The 'stark' theme is installed (e.g. drush theme:enable stark) and, after a router/cache rebuild (drush cr), the dynamic route styleguide.stark exists so /admin/appearance/styleguide/stark renders the guide in the stark theme.
